The '''Old Mandalorians''' were a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] exiled by the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] after their [[Great Clan Wars/Legends|Civil War]].

The language of [[Mando'a/Legends|Mando'a]] was especially used among the Old Mandalorians, who believed that the language allowed more precision in speech when discussing combat.

Members of clans [[Clan Awaud/Legends|Awaud]] and [[Clan Beroya|Beroya]] were among the Old Mandalorians. Those living on [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]] had entered into an alliance with one of the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] groups living on the world, the Gnaaz tribe.

==History==
Like the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], the Old Mandalorians were exiled from their [[Mandalore/Legends|homeworld]] after the Great Clan Wars.

Prior the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Nam Beroya/Legends|Nam Beroya]] led three hundred Mandalorians to [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]] and founded the settlement of [[Arumorut]], where their number would eventually grow to eight hundred.

Following their hiring by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents, three dozen Old Mandalorians from Vlemoth Port, including Nam and Vera Beroya, would take part in the [[Battle of Xorrn/Legends|Battle of Xorrn]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Mandalorian society traditionally centered around warfare. Throughout history, its members fought for both honor and credits with equal fervor. Recently, Mandalorian culture has fractured into three separate groups: The New Mandalorians, the Death Watch, and the Old Mandalorians. |[[Friends Like These]] |<ref name="Friends Like These" />}}
The Old Mandalorians were first introduced to the ''[[Star Wars]]'' universe in the [[roleplaying game]] adventure book ''[[Friends Like These]]'', published on [[December 8]], [[2016]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].
